narrative.overview:
AI Field Kit is a warm field-paper installation guide that makes a multi-agent setup legible as a route. The ocean structure comes from Logbook for Devs: Deep Ocean holds the decisive operational surfaces, Verdigris marks focus and confirmation, Signal Rust carries route energy, and Brass pinpoints an active installation choice.

One AFK core sends four dashed routes to named agent nodes. Ledger rows, a sticky layer stack, real install tabs, and runnable command panels turn that visual route into an operational decision trail. The light-only page remains a technical field journal instead of a generic AI landing page or a decorative card wall.
keyCharacteristics: Poppins UI/display, Literata narrative emphasis, one Caveat field note, and IBM Plex Mono technical labels.
Warm field paper with a fixed, fading grid and clear ruled boundaries.
Deep Ocean operations, Verdigris focus, Signal Rust route signal, and Brass active detail.
Route-map, ledger, manual, and manifest structures make AFK composition visible.
Motion respects reduced-motion preferences without concealing information.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Docs use fixed-size Poppins headings, generous 1.8 body leading, and a bounded reading column; the homepage hero scale does not transfer to articles.

rules.name: The In-Place Command Feedback Rule
rules.body: Docs commands reserve an inline status region for copy success or a manual-selection fallback; feedback clears after three seconds without moving to a toast. The region reserves `28px` minimum height and uses `0 18px 8px` padding.

rules.name: The Ocean Carries Operations Rule
rules.body: Deep Ocean carries the strongest action, code, and major operational surfaces. Signal Rust is not the ordinary CTA fill.

rules.name: The Accent Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Verdigris indicates focus or available action, Rust indicates route/signal, and Brass indicates active instrument detail.

rules.name: The Bottle Letter Rule
rules.body: Poppins is the durable interface, Literata is the rare human note, and IBM Plex Mono verifies the coordinates. Do not restore superseded font roles.

rules.name: The Route Explains Composition Rule
rules.body: Use routes, ledger rows, named layers, and real commands to explain setup ownership before adding decorative containers.

dos: Do keep docs article sections unframed, code wrapping, chapter URLs stable, and copy feedback in place.
Do use the native mobile chapter selector and docs-specific breakpoints instead of compressing the desktop rails.
Do use the exact ocean semantic accents: Deep Ocean #102c2c, Verdigris #3f8580, Signal Rust #c94f35, and Brass #bd9348.
Do preserve the current tab, copy, skip-link, focus, and reduced-motion contracts.
Do keep Poppins for interface structure, Literata for sparse narrative emphasis, and Plex Mono for technical labels.
Do keep the responsive route from desktop instrument to a single-column mobile reading order.
donts: Don't transfer the homepage hero scale, route animation, or raised instrument treatment into docs prose.
Don't describe the title filter as full-text search or the existing docs mark as an official stack-native logo.
Don't restore superseded typography, palette, or token claims.
Don't turn the warm base into a brown-led beige identity; keep ocean semantics visibly present.
Don't replace the route, ledger, and manifest structures with generic card walls.
Don't make motion necessary to understand installation paths or hide content under reduced motion.
